# Welcome to the FED-LINk Discussions

This document is the welcome message shown for the repository's
[Discussions](https://github.com/fedpromptly/infinityfree-shortener-builder/discussions)
area. Keep the tone friendly and practical: this is the front door for
questions, ideas and showing off what you built with FED-LINk.

## What FED-LINk is

FED-LINk turns a plain links file into a complete short-link bundle for
InfinityFree: redirect folders, an Apache `.htaccess`, a 404 fallback and a
single `links.zip` you upload to `htdocs`. You own the domain, you own the
links, no third-party redirect service involved.

## Where to post what

- **Q&A** — questions about setup, DNS at IONOS, InfinityFree uploads, or
  the CLI commands. Check the FAQ in the wiki first; your question may
  already be answered.
- **Ideas** — feature proposals and wishes for the builder, the desktop
  app or the Android app.
- **Show and tell** — show off the short links you deployed and how you
  use them; screenshots welcome.
- **General** — anything else that does not fit the categories above.

Bug reports belong in [Issues](https://github.com/fedpromptly/infinityfree-shortener-builder/issues),
not Discussions — the issue templates make triage much easier.

## Ground rules

1. Be kind and patient; everyone here is volunteering their time.
2. Search before posting; duplicates get merged quickly.
3. Do not post account credentials, panel passwords or private URLs —
   redact them first.
4. Keep conversations in English so the widest audience can follow.
